task.title: 搜索 All Settings
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Search configured settings, available policies, known preferences, and setting actions from All Settings.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Open All Settings in any mode.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Search is shared across Review, Configured, and Catalog work. It can lead to a setting, an action, or a filtered group.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Place focus in the All Settings search field.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Enter a policy ID, preference key, category, source, or plain-language term.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Choose a grouped result and confirm the target setting or action.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：搜索 All Settings. Clear the search when you return to browsing or filtering.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The matching setting or action is selected without losing the current profile context.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if no result appears, confirm the schema channel and try a policy ID or preference key.
